assets.prompt:
Create ONE original Minecraft inventory UPGRADE MODULE texture, informed by the attached reference strip. The first three reference icons show the MEKANISM module structure (metal card, recessed dark panel, electrical contacts); the blue and pink ingots and last icon show BOTANIA material colors. Use them only as design references; invent a new module. This is a small hardware cartridge, NOT a flower, plant, jewelry, gemstone cluster, rune tablet or a decorative badge.

CRITICAL OUTPUT: a square, perfectly front-facing, full-bleed face of the module itself. Its flat dark-metal outer plate fills EVERY pixel of the entire square canvas, including all four corners. NO external background, NO margin, NO transparency, NO checkerboard. The image boundaries ARE the square hardware plate boundaries, like a complete square Minecraft item sprite. The entire module is just a flat inventory icon, not a perspective cube or product photograph.

It must be designed as EXACTLY 16 by 16 large logical square pixel cells, enlarged. Show 16 cells across total. No smaller details, no anti-aliasing, no gradients, no glows, no noise or texture within cells. Very coarse limited-palette pixel art, 10 flat colors maximum. Four dark-gray square corners; a slim desaturated steel rim with tiny cobalt manasteel edge highlights; recessed charcoal central work panel. Along the TOP edge three clearly separate copper-gold contact teeth, each only one logical pixel wide and two tall. About 70 percent of the face is charcoal/steel, with Botania's blue manasteel and saturated mana-colored functional symbol. The frame, socket and contacts are identical across the family. No text, labels, letters, numbers, flowers, leaves or ornamental vines. No surrounding diagram, frame outside the physical module, duplicate thumbnail or alternate view. Main symbol is only 6 by 6 logical pixels, centered in the panel. RANGE module: the central CYAN glyph consists of a tiny center square and two separated angular bracket arcs to left and right, suggesting an expanding field. Geometric and blocky, like a compact Botania spark augment symbol embedded in a Mek upgrade card. Cobalt-blue manasteel socket accents.
